objectives: Order food from a street cart or stall
Ask about prices and pay in cash
Ask for extras like sauce and napkins

grammar.explanation: Use 'some' in polite requests and positive sentences, and 'any' in questions and negatives. We say 'Can I have some sauce?' but 'Do you have any napkins?' and 'We don't have any ketchup.' Remember: much goes with uncountable nouns and many goes with countable nouns.
grammar.explanationAr: نستخدم some في الطلب المهذب والجمل المثبتة، ونستخدم any في الأسئلة والنفي. وكلمة much توضع مع الأسماء غير المعدودة، أما many فتوضع مع الأسماء المعدودة.
